titulo: Folha de modelagem de cenario: pisos
prompt: MODEL SHEET for 3D modeling (environment kit pieces) for the action-RPG "Echoes of the Shatter", area Cripta Partida (broken crypt). Attached image 1 is the canonical, owner-approved design sheet of OUR game: copy the design of every piece from its kit panel exactly (same grey-violet stone, worn gold inlays and trims, red banners, bones, amber fire, same proportions and materials). Attached image 2 shows the ground textures of the areas (use it for the stone floor look). The other attached images are texture contact sheets of the style reference game: use them only for the finish quality. Every piece must look like a finished in-game 3D asset of a polished stylized game: sculpted, rounded, chunky bevelled volumes with chipped worn edges, irregular hand-carved stone, hand-painted textures with visible brush strokes and soft baked light and ambient occlusion. It must NOT look like straight plain blocks, cubes, Lego bricks, voxels or a graybox: no perfectly straight edges, no sharp 90-degree corners, everything softly bevelled and slightly uneven. LAYOUT: a clean grid of rows, one row per piece, each row with the FRONT view on the left and the SIDE view on the right of that same piece.  Each piece is fully isolated (never touching another piece), fully visible with a clear margin, and shown at a consistent scale across the sheet. Orthographic look, no perspective distortion; the FRONT view is straight-on and the SIDE view is a straight profile, both aligned on the same ground line. PIECES: FLOOR TILES, three variations of a square 2 m by 2 m crypt floor slab (flat, about 0.25 m thick, edges bevelled so it can tile): (A) plain cracked flagstones of grey-violet stone with small chips; (B) the same stone with a worn golden ring-and-star inlay segment crossing the slab; (C) heavily broken and sunken slab with missing chunks, a crack and small rubble. For floors the front view is the top-down view and the side view shows the thickness profile. Plain flat uniform light grey background (#C8C8C8), no floor, no cast shadow, no scenery, no characters, no text, no labels, no numbers, no dimension lines, no grid, no frame, no UI. Even neutral lighting so the colors read as albedo, with only soft painted shading; fire and glow only as small painted emissive parts. Do not reproduce any existing asset from the reference game one-to-one.
